purpose: Remedy the second completion audit's verified boundary omission. Earlier scoped metrics/data/results remain unchanged and cannot certify the complete pipeline.
production_changes: Identical measurement-only instrumentation on baseline and candidate; no further optimization, logger change, required behavior removal or work reduction before this campaign.
primary_metric: Equal-weight mean base_builder_complete_block_build_active_duration in ms/canonical block across transfer/storage x legacy/Azul, each 25%.
boundary: Async PayloadBuilder::try_build entry immediately before calling build_payload, through all build_payload state/provider/cache/iterator/context/future cleanup and the final watch::Sender::send_replace handoff, including disposal of the replaced payload. Stop immediately after that handoff/drop and before recording instrumentation or returning Ok. All context/provider setup, selection/metering, execution, roots/finalization, serialization and earlier websocket/payload-channel handoffs remain inside.
scheduled_waits: Subtract only the same explicit tokio::select inter-flashblock waiting intervals measured inside build_payload. Propagate that Duration to try_build without additional allocation. No cleanup, handoff, locking, serialization, logging, execution or other wait is subtracted.
legacy_metrics: Keep original active_block_build_duration and block_build_wall_duration unchanged for historical comparison and additional 5% guards. Add complete_block_build_active_duration and complete_block_build_wall_duration, requiring exactly one of each per measured successful canonical block. Require complete durations >= scoped durations and active <= wall.
workload_and_state: Unchanged original reference and strengthened normal/stress definitions from block-building-contract.json and block-building-audit-contract.json: fresh persisted chain901 MDBX fixture per process, matching sparse64MiB limits; 2warmups/10measured; all declared work included; independent validator canonical parity; original logger and default features/allocator; release opt3/thinLTO/16CGU/unwind/debugnone/stripsymbols.
environment: macOS26.7.1 build25G241, AppleM5Pro Mac17,8 arm64,18logicalCPUs,48GiB, Rust1.96.0; no cross-OS pooling; no builds/tests/profiling during sampling.
order: Independent process per workload/version/pair; alternate baseline/candidate on odd/even pairs. Run all matrices; exclude no observations or completed runs. Any smoke/debug samples are separate and never accepted.
acceptance: On the complete-call reference metric, O<=0.85B and paired two-sided95% Student-t lower bound>=15%. Normal/stress cannot substitute or reweight the primary suite.
safety: Unchanged5% per-workload relative noise tolerance on complete active/wall p95, scoped active/wall p95, driver p95 and peakRSS; p95 remains mean of per-run nearest-rank maxima with10samples, never pooled. Full inclusion/equalgas/independentcanonicalparity/publicationcounts/persistence/critical-task/panic guards remain. Zero payload-job expirations/missing/reducedframes and complete-wall processing-budget breaches (1.5s reference/stress,2.5s normal); reject absent observations.
stopping: Exactly fixed5/15/5 pairs for this campaign; retain failures without outcome-driven extension. If complete mean/lower-bound or a safety guard fails, goal remains incomplete and requires investigation plus any newly predeclared campaign before further optimization.
limitations: Synthetic production-code-path/load-shape coverage; not mainnet state replay or production-host timing. Older scoped reports and oldOS failed normal cohorts remain retained scoped/failed evidence; no claim they were fixed. Goal complete only after a new independent completion audit approves.
